The DOI is **10.1515/THLI.2008.007** ([De Gruyter record](https://degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/THLI.2008.007/pdf)), which is Croft & Poole's article in *Theoretical Linguistics*, not *Linguistic Typology*. So the team note's "lity" DOI pattern doesn't apply to this paper, and I'd ignore it. The page is paywalled, so I confirmed the title and DOI from the publisher's listing rather than the article's front matter.

CONFIDENCE: 80
